summary: FirstService Corp filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a quarterly cash dividend of US$0.305 per common share, payable on July 7, 2026 to holders of record on June 30, 2026. The dividend is declared by the board of directors as a routine capital return to shareholders and constitutes an eligible dividend for Canadian tax purposes. No special-situation event is present; the filing is a routine current report of a regular dividend declaration by a foreign private issuer. There are no deal terms, activist activities, or structural changes to analyze.
